scope: Local result-sharing experiment, not a framework implementation or network benchmark

lanes.independent: Three independently written SQL queries; one JSON response
lanes.combined: One SQL statement, shared materialized join, three full result arrays
lanes.shared: Same combined SQL as combined; server deduplicates identical rows and returns ordered references

controls.isolation: No concurrent writes during any comparison; all lanes read the same unchanged state
controls.supported: Same scoped row projection, unique order ID, inner many-orders-to-one-customer join, deterministic total orders
controls.boundary: Same data and SQL shapes; bucket parameters [0,0,0] versus [0,1,2]
controls.timing: Warm in-memory PGlite including JS result decode; 3 warmups, 21 interleaved samples; no network or browser DB apply
controls.payload: Actual JSON/gzip of this experimental envelope, not the Start wire protocol
controls.excludes: Auth changes, multi-snapshot reads, optimistic overlays, missing/expired baselines, general projections, many-to-many multiplicity, production PG planning/load

witnesses: customer update changes four untouched orders
